title: Operation Sindoor: All Lies Exposed.
description:
Operation Sindoor, like many major national actions, has been surrounded by misinformation and propaganda—both internal and external. Internally, political parties and media houses with vested interests have either exaggerated its success or downplayed its intent, turning a strategic operation into a political narrative. Some falsely claimed it was a mission with zero problems, while others branded it as a complete failure without understanding ground realities.

Externally, anti-India elements, including hostile foreign media and propaganda networks, spread fake stories of human rights violations, civilian harm, or political motivations, ignoring the real security threats the operation addressed.

This video exposes both sides—how facts were twisted, narratives were manufactured, and how the real story was lost in noise.
